subject: Upfront commit invoicing and FY split — AtlasOps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Torres <maya.torres@atlasops.com>, AtlasOps Finance <finance@atlasops.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upfront commit — invoicing cadence and FY split?

Hi Maya / AtlasOps finance team,

Thanks again for the productive call on the 3yr upfront. Per our commercial terms, AtlasOps will take a $2.4M committed prepay (3-year term) with the agreed 25% discount on list. Before we finalize the SOW, finance asked whether Redwood can split the upfront invoice into multiple invoices to align with your fiscal years.

Quick context: AtlasOps closes books on 12/31. Their procurement / AP team prefers invoices that align to the receiving year for ease of amortization. Two options that came up in internal planning:
- Single upfront invoice issued on signature date (Redwood default)
- Split invoices issued across fiscal years (e.g., 2026 and 2027) to match your capex/opex preferences

Can you confirm which your accounting team prefers? If you want the split, what % split or exact amounts do you need? I’ve attached the latest SOW (Redwood_SOW_AtlasOps_3yr_upfront_v2.pdf) and a proposed invoice schedule.

Next steps: once you confirm, Diego from Rev Ops will advise on ledger entries and we’ll update the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_AtlasOps_3yr_upfront_v2.pdf (pdf), proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx (xlsx)
From: AtlasOps Finance <finance@atlasops.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Torres <maya.torres@atlasops.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 07:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upfront commit — invoicing cadence and FY split?

Karthik,

Thanks for the note and the SOW. Our accounting group (cc’d: Connor Li) prefers split invoices so we can recognize the spend across FY26 and FY27. Two specific asks:
1) Can Redwood issue two invoices tied to the same SOW / PO?
2) We need exact invoice dates and amounts to provide to our Rev Rec team to map deferred revenue. Ideally the split would be 60% in FY26 and 40% in FY27 for cashflow alignment.

Also — are you able to provide a short memo on how Redwood treats revenue recognition for upfront prepay (invoice date vs. service period) and a sample ledger mapping we can share? Connor will hold the PO until we have invoices scheduled.

Best,
Finance Team
AtlasOps

--
Connor Li
Accounting Manager, AtlasOps
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: AtlasOps Finance <finance@atlasops.com>, Maya Torres <maya.torres@atlasops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upfront commit — invoicing cadence and FY split?

Connor / Maya,

Thanks — we can absolutely accommodate a split invoicing approach. High-level guidance below to align the commercial, billing, and rev-rec sides:

1) Commercial treatment
- SOW remains for the full $2.4M prepay (3yr). Deal ID: ATL-2026-0897.
- We’ll issue two invoices that reference the same SOW and the PO number you provide.

2) Proposed invoice schedule (draft)
- Invoice A (FY26): issue date 2026-09-01 — Amount: $1,440,000 (60%)
- Invoice B (FY27): issue date 2027-01-03 — Amount: $960,000 (40%)
- Net payment terms: 30 days for each invoice (standard)

3) Revenue recognition notes (high level)
- Redwood invoices upfront but recognizes revenue over the service term. For ASC 606 / general rev-rec: the invoice triggers AR; revenue is deferred and amortized over the 36-month service period starting from effective date on the SOW (2026-09-01 assumed).
- If AtlasOps prefers invoice timing to match fiscal periods, we will issue separate invoices as above but the rev-rec team should amortize each invoice pro rata over the remaining service months from each invoice’s effective coverage window. We’ll provide a sample amort schedule.

4) Ledger/GL guidance
- Invoice entry: Debit AR (invoice amount) / Credit Unearned Revenue (deferred)
- Monthly amort: Debit Unearned Revenue / Credit Subscription Revenue (pro rata)

5) Operational notes
- We will stamp both invoices with the SOW number and reference ATL-2026-0897.
- If you need different invoice dates (e.g., to hit specific FY cutoffs), confirm exact dates and we’ll draft final invoice PDFs accordingly.

I’ve attached a quick template (invoice-split-template.csv) and a proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx that Laura prepared. If this looks good, Karthik will circulate an updated DocuSign envelope for signature and we’ll queue the invoice generation with billing.

Diego Fernandez
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice-split-template.csv (csv), proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, AtlasOps Finance <finance@atlasops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upfront commit — invoicing cadence and FY split?

Connor / team,

Adding a few operational specifics from Billing:
- We can generate multiple invoices against one SOW; our billing system will tie them to the same revenue contract id.
- Suggested invoice numbering convention: ATL-INV-2026-001 (for Invoice A) and ATL-INV-2027-001 (for Invoice B) — this helps your AP referencing.
- Please confirm the PO number and the exact amount per invoice.

I attached a CSV template you can populate with PO, billing address, and remittance info — will speed up generation.

Laura Bennett
Senior Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
